prompt: Round 3 of 4. The researcher side proposes (We want university ownership of results to support publication of a publicly releasable annotated GPR benchmark, whi

content.text:
The university wants uni_owns_nonexclusive_licence with 12 months exclusivity. We want company ownership. Let me trade: accept uni_owns_option_to_assign (gives us a path to ownership) and keep 12 months exclusivity, or push for uni_owns_option_to_licence with longer exclusivity.

Actually, let me think about what's most important to us: we want to integrate results into our products. A non-exclusive licence means competitors could get the same licence. We should push for at least uni_owns_option_to_assign or company_owns_uni_academic_use.

Trade: accept 12 months exclusivity (down from 18) in exchange for upgrading ip to uni_owns_option_to_assign. That gives us a path to full ownership.
So I'll set ip to uni_owns_option_to_assign and leave exclusivity at 12 months.
